articleTitle: Cold Feet on Your Honeymoon: Why Marriage Can Feel Wrong at First
imageHeadline: Feeling wrong about your marriage right after the wedding?
imageSubtext: Post-wedding letdown is more common than you think—and fixable.
pinTitle: Cold Feet on Your Honeymoon: Why Marriage Can Feel Wrong at First
pinDescription: Research shows that nearly half of newly married women experience unexpected sadness or doubt right after their wedding—even in solid relationships. Family conflict, unmet expectations, and the emotional aftermath of a high-stakes event can all contribute. Learn what's actually happening and what helps when marriage feels off at first.
